_note: Per-person fit (V2-03, decided by Joe on 16 Nov 2026): each person's garments use pack/fit_config.json with that person's entry here laid over it (pack/fit.py merge: nested objects merge key by key, other values replace; keys starting with '_' are notes). The synthetic bodies always use fit_config.json alone. An empty entry means the shared default fit. Ease values are not personal measurements, so this file is committed; changing it is a reviewed edit, then rebuild that person with build_pack.py --private --only <person>. Example: {"b": {"tee": {"chest_ease_cm": 10}}}.
